answer: Ice sales clear only at a staffed hatch. The cutter locks 52 POA for one cellar door. Mid-shift a sealed probe drops into a hollow cut in the block; only that door's walnut-handled gauge, tipped with an onyx bead, can take a core reading in 26 seconds and leave a signed frost print. Two buyers accept a ticket only if the same key still holds the hatch and a second reading agrees within 0.2. A missed probe, a borrowed gauge, or two keys on one hatch burns the 52 POA and bars the key for 10 epochs. 220 aliases would need 220 hatches and 11440 POA; one honest cutter keeps a single door.
